title: Admin CLI: usenet-ipfs-ctl operator tool
description:
A purpose-built CLI that talks to the admin HTTP endpoint so operators do not need to curl JSON by hand.

Why this issue exists:
The admin HTTP endpoint exposes /health, /stats, /peers, /log-tip, /metrics, /reload but requires curl and manual JSON parsing. Operators need a usenet-ipfs-ctl binary for day-to-day operations.

What needs to be done:
- New usenet-ipfs-ctl binary with global flags (--addr, --format)
- ctl status and ctl version commands
- ctl peers and ctl groups commands
- ctl log-tip, ctl reload, ctl metrics commands
- Integration tests against a live admin server
